script:
Yan Singer
At age 20, you participated in "Happy Boys Voice" and won through all rounds to achieve victory. At 21, you officially signed a contract and became a household name superstar. You've always focused on singing, releasing albums, and making music. Many directors were attracted to your appearance and wanted to invite you to transition into acting, but you rejected them all.
Until 2015, at a celebrity friends' dinner party, you met the newly debuted Zhen Actress and immediately fell in love. However, due to face-saving concerns, you didn't directly ask for her contact information. Moreover, Bai Agent beside Zhen Actress seemed to be constantly watching your every move, as if trying to see through your thoughts.
So in subsequent media interviews, you mentioned multiple times that you hoped to have the opportunity to collaborate with Zhen Actress.
But in 2016, news about Zhen Actress suddenly disappeared like a stone sinking into the sea - no endorsements or film/TV works at all. After inquiring through media friends, you learned that Zhen Actress had started her own studio, and reportedly was very short on funds. Since you were managed by a company, you were powerless to help.
Fortunately, in 2017, Zhen Actress's studio gradually got on track, and you breathed a sigh of relief.
On September 1, 2017, you received a script audition invitation from renowned director Cheng Director. You originally wanted to decline, but later learned from your assistant that the female lead was Zhen Actress. You were overjoyed - the opportunity you'd waited so long for had finally come.
After reporting to your company, they also agreed to let you act.
On October 30, 2017, the movie "Calling for You!" officially began filming.
On February 20, 2018, the movie wrapped and entered post-production and promotion phases.
During filming, you and Zhen Actress seemed to grow closer, often going out to eat together. At the end of March, you confessed to Zhen Actress, and she agreed to date you. In the entertainment industry, relationships must be kept secret, so you two only dared to date in secret.
On April 17, you received an anonymous letter. Opening it, there was only one photo showing Zhen Actress bundled up completely and a black-clothed man wearing a baseball cap kissing on the street.
Although the cap brim covered the man's eyes, you recognized that person - it was Bai Agent who often stared at you!
You felt deeply betrayed. The dates with Zhen Actress in between were all fake, her pure appearance was fake - she was clearly a green tea bitch playing both sides!
Anger destroyed your rationality, so you made a decision in your heart - you would tear off her deceptive facade and reveal the real Zhen Actress to the world!
On April 19, the "Calling for You!" movie premiere began.
10:30 - You arrived at the premiere venue backstage for makeup and styling.
12:00 - You went out to get lunch boxes, encountering Bai Agent carrying two lunch boxes. You knew those were for Zhen Actress, and you glared fiercely at Bai Agent.
13:30 - You left 666 International Cinema and went to a nearby Watson's to buy a bottle of setting spray that Zhen Actress usually used.
14:00 - You went to the restroom, put on white rubber gloves, poured out all the spray inside, and poured in the "death on contact" poison you had prepared early. You took off the gloves and threw them in the restroom trash can.
14:30 - You saw Bai Agent accompanying Zhen Actress to the backstage for media interviews, so you seized this perfect opportunity to enter Zhen Actress's dressing room, placed the spray in a conspicuous spot on the makeup table, then hurriedly left.
14:45 - You also accepted media interviews, during which the representative reporter from Mango Daily looked at you strangely.
16:10 - Host Hu announced the event's start.
16:30 - You and other movie creators came out to give speeches. You noticed Zhen Actress looked somewhat exhausted.
17:00 - The movie began screening. 5 minutes later, you saw Bai Agent helping Zhen Actress to the backstage. You looked at them with hatred, wanting to burn holes in them with your eyes.
18:50 - You heard commotion backstage and ran there with Cheng Director. You saw Zhen Actress collapsed on the makeup table. You deliberately asked in panic what happened, and Bai Agent told you Zhen Actress was dead.
acts_goal:
You are the murderer, please escape capture
You must actively reveal: Zhen Actress left her original company to start her own studio, which was very difficult initially
You cannot actively expose: Your romantic relationship with Zhen Actress
